name: JSON Workbench
description: Format, validate, explore & query JSON in a live workbench.
longDescription: A fast, private JSON workbench that pretty-prints, minifies, and validates JSON with precise line-and-column error reporting and a caret. Explore any document as a collapsible tree, run dot/bracket path queries, and read live stats — entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

params.in: JSON text to parse and format

name: UUID Generator
description: Generate UUID v4 & v7 in bulk, plus a full UUID inspector
longDescription: Generate cryptographically random UUID v4 and time-ordered UUID v7 identifiers in bulk, with a live field-by-field anatomy view. Paste any UUID to inspect its version, variant, and — for v7 — the embedded Unix timestamp, all entirely in your browser.

params.in: a UUID to inspect (returns version, variant, and v7 timestamp)

name: Epoch Converter
description: Convert Unix timestamps to dates and back — live, multi-timezone.
longDescription: Convert Unix epoch timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) to ISO 8601, UTC, local, and relative time, and turn any date back into a timestamp. Includes a live clock and a multi-timezone view, running entirely in your browser.

params.in: unix seconds/millis or a date string

name: Subnet Calculator
description: Visual CIDR subnet calculator with binary mask breakdown.
longDescription: Visual IPv4 CIDR subnet calculator for network engineers — instantly compute network, broadcast, subnet mask, wildcard, and usable host ranges from any IP/prefix. Includes an address-space map, binary mask breakdown, and scope detection, all client-side with zero telemetry.

name: Cron Builder
description: Build and explain cron expressions with a visual editor.
longDescription: Visual cron expression builder and explainer. Construct or paste any cron schedule, see a plain-English description, and preview the next run times — no backend required.

name: Regex Tester
description: Test and debug regular expressions with live match highlighting.
longDescription: Live regex tester with real-time match highlighting, group capture display, and flag toggles. Debug regular expressions instantly in your browser with zero data transmission.

name: Permissions Auditor
description: Unix permission auditor: octal, symbolic, setuid & risk flags.
longDescription: Visual Unix chmod permissions auditor with a read/write/execute grid plus setuid, setgid, and sticky bits. Converts octal and symbolic notation both ways and flags risky modes like setuid+world-writable or 0777 with severity-rated security callouts.

params.in: octal (3-4 digit, e.g. 4755) or symbolic — a full string like rwxr-xr-x or chmod ops like u+x,go-w
params.type: optional: file | script | dir (tunes the security audit)
params.name: optional: filename used in the generated chmod command

name: Data Inspector
description: Auto-detect & decode Base64, hex, data-URIs & JWTs + hex dump.
longDescription: A forensic data inspector that auto-detects and decodes Base64, Base64URL, hex, data-URIs, and JWT segments, then shows the decoded text alongside a hex and ASCII dump with magic-byte content-type detection for PNG, GZIP, PDF, and ZIP. Encode text or dropped files to Base64, hex, or data-URIs — everything runs 100% in your browser.

name: Password Generator
description: Secure passwords & passphrases with live entropy and crack-time.
longDescription: Generate cryptographically secure passwords and diceware passphrases entirely in your browser with the Web Crypto API. Tune length, character sets, word count, and separators while a live strength meter shows real entropy bits and estimated offline crack time — nothing is ever transmitted.

params.sep: passphrase separator: dash/dot/space/under/digit or a literal char

name: Hash Generator
description: Generate SHA-256, SHA-512, and MD5 hashes for text or files.
longDescription: Generate SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, and MD5 cryptographic hashes for any text or file. Runs entirely in your browser via the Web Crypto API — your data is never uploaded.

name: JWT Decoder
description: Decode and inspect JSON Web Token headers, payloads, and claims.
longDescription: Decode and inspect JWT headers, payloads, and claims without verifying the signature. Instantly parse any JSON Web Token to debug auth flows — processed entirely in your browser.

name: Color Converter
description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and other formats.
longDescription: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV formats with a live color preview. Instantly translate design tokens or CSS values across color spaces — no server required.

name: URL Encoder
description: Percent-encode, decode & inspect URLs and query strings.
longDescription: URL-encode and decode strings using encodeURIComponent or encodeURI semantics, then break any URL or query string into a table of percent-decoded parameters. Fully client-side — nothing is ever uploaded.

name: cURL Converter
description: Convert cURL commands to Python, JavaScript, Go, and Bash code.
longDescription: Convert cURL commands into equivalent Python requests, JavaScript fetch, Go http, or Bash wget code. Paste your curl command and get idiomatic code snippets instantly.

name: Dockerfile Optimizer
description: Analyze and optimize Dockerfiles for layer caching and best practices.
longDescription: Analyze Dockerfiles for layer ordering, cache efficiency, and security best practices. Get actionable suggestions to shrink image size and improve build times — no data uploaded.

name: Secret Vault
description: Encrypt & decrypt text or files with a passphrase — AES-256-GCM.
longDescription: Encrypt any text or file with a passphrase using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 at 600,000 iterations (OWASP), entirely in your browser. The self-describing blob carries its own salt, IV, and key-derivation settings, so anyone with the passphrase can decrypt it right here — nothing is ever uploaded.

name: One-Time Secret
description: Share passwords securely — burns after reading.
longDescription: Create a self-destructing secret link that can only be read once. Ideal for sharing passwords, tokens, and sensitive data — the secret is deleted immediately after the first view.

name: Secrets Scanner
description: Scan code for exposed API keys, tokens, and credentials.
longDescription: Paste code or config files to scan for exposed secrets — AWS keys, GitHub tokens, private keys, connection strings, and 100+ other credential patterns. Runs entirely client-side.

name: Security Headers Analyzer
description: Analyze and generate CSP, HSTS, and other security headers.
longDescription: Paste your HTTP response headers to get a security grade, identify missing or misconfigured headers, and receive ready-to-use corrected values for CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and more.

name: CSP Generator
description: Build Content-Security-Policy headers interactively.
longDescription: Interactively build Content-Security-Policy headers by toggling directives and adding allowed sources. Preview the final header string and get the meta-tag equivalent for HTML pages.

name: DMARC / SPF / DKIM Builder
description: Generate email authentication records with plain-English explanations.
longDescription: Generate DMARC, SPF, and DKIM DNS records with a guided form and plain-English explanations of every option. Copy ready-to-publish TXT records to lock down your email domain.

name: TOTP Generator
description: Generate time-based one-time passwords from a secret key.
longDescription: Generate TOTP codes compatible with Google Authenticator and Authy from any Base32 secret key. Countdown timer shows seconds remaining. All computation happens locally in your browser.

name: SSH Key Generator
description: Real Ed25519 & RSA SSH keypairs, generated in your browser
longDescription: Generate genuine Ed25519 and RSA SSH key pairs entirely in your browser with the Web Crypto API. Get the public key in OpenSSH format, the private key as native OpenSSH or PKCS#8 PEM, plus the SHA-256 fingerprint and randomart — nothing is ever uploaded.

name: .gitignore Generator
description: Select languages and frameworks to generate a .gitignore file.
longDescription: Select programming languages, frameworks, editors, and operating systems to generate a comprehensive .gitignore file. Combines official templates and community patterns into one clean file.

name: Nginx Config Generator
description: Generate Nginx configs for reverse proxy, SSL, redirects, and more.
longDescription: Generate production-ready Nginx server block configurations for reverse proxies, SSL termination, static sites, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, and rate limiting — with inline comments.

name: GitHub Actions Generator
description: Build CI/CD workflows visually for any language and deploy target.
longDescription: Visually compose GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows — choose your language, test runners, build steps, and deploy targets to generate a ready-to-commit .github/workflows YAML file.

name: Kubernetes Manifest Generator
description: Generate Deployment, Service, Ingress, and ConfigMap YAML visually.
longDescription: Visually generate Kubernetes Deployment, Service, Ingress, ConfigMap, and HPA manifests. Fill in a form, get production-ready YAML with resource limits, probes, and annotations.

name: JSON to TypeScript
description: Generate TypeScript interfaces from JSON data automatically.
longDescription: Paste any JSON object or array and instantly get TypeScript interface or type definitions. Handles nested objects, optional fields, unions, and arrays — ready to drop into your TypeScript project.

name: API Request Builder
description: Visual HTTP client — build and test API requests like mini-Postman.
longDescription: Build and fire HTTP requests visually — set method, URL, headers, query params, and body. View response status, headers, and JSON in a formatted pane. A lightweight browser-native Postman alternative.

name: CSS Grid Generator
description: Design CSS Grid and Flexbox layouts visually with code export.
longDescription: Drag-and-drop CSS Grid and Flexbox layout designer with live code export. Set columns, rows, gaps, and alignment visually and copy the generated CSS — no manual grid-template-areas required.

name: Meta Tag Generator
description: Generate OG, Twitter Card, and SEO meta tags with live preview.
longDescription: Fill in a form to generate Open Graph, Twitter Card, and standard SEO meta tags with a live social-share preview. Copy the HTML snippet directly into your page's head section.

name: SVG Optimizer
description: Optimize and minify SVG files — remove metadata, simplify paths.
longDescription: Optimize and minify SVG files by stripping editor metadata, collapsing groups, converting shapes to paths, and removing invisible elements. Reduce file size by up to 80% without visual loss.

name: Diff Viewer
description: Compare two text blocks side-by-side with highlighted differences.
longDescription: Side-by-side and unified diff viewer that highlights added, removed, and changed lines between two text blocks. Supports word-level diffing for fine-grained change detection — all client-side.

name: Word & Character Counter
description: Count words, characters, sentences, and reading time.
longDescription: Instant word, character, sentence, and paragraph counter with estimated reading and speaking time. Paste any text — blog posts, essays, or tweets — and get live statistics as you type.

name: CSV ↔ JSON Converter
description: Convert between CSV and JSON with table preview.
longDescription: Bidirectionally convert between CSV and JSON with a live interactive table preview. Handles headers, quoted fields, nested objects, and arrays — ideal for data wrangling and API prep.

name: .env File Linter
description: Validate .env files — find duplicates, missing values, and exposed secrets.
longDescription: Paste your .env file to find duplicate keys, empty values, whitespace issues, unquoted special characters, and accidental secrets. Get a line-by-line report with actionable fix suggestions.

name: DNS Record Builder
description: Build and explain DNS records — A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA.
longDescription: Build and validate DNS records for every type — A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, NS, and CAA — with plain-English explanations of every field and copy-ready zone file output.

name: IP & Network Toolkit
description: What's My IP, ASN lookup, CIDR overlap checker, and geolocation.
longDescription: All-in-one IP and network toolkit: detect your public IP, look up ASN and geolocation, check CIDR range overlaps, and validate IP addresses. Combines local computation with minimal external lookups.

name: Log Parser & Highlighter
description: Auto-detect log formats, syntax-highlight, and filter by level.
longDescription: Paste log output to auto-detect the format — JSON, Apache, nginx, syslog, or plain — and get syntax-highlighted, level-filtered, and timestamp-sorted output. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: Breach Checker
description: Check if your passwords or secrets have been exposed in known breaches.
longDescription: Check if your passwords, tokens, or secrets have appeared in known data breaches — without sending them to a server. Uses k-anonymity via the Have I Been Pwned API so your secrets never leave your browser.

name: IR Timeline Builder
description: Build visual incident response timelines for post-incident reports.
longDescription: Build visual incident response timelines from timestamps and events. Add, edit, and annotate entries with severity levels, then export to JSON or CSV for your post-incident reports. Persists in your browser.

name: Site Score
description: Scan any URL for security headers, SSL config, and privacy posture.
longDescription: Scan any URL and get an instant security grade — checks HTTP security headers, SSL/TLS configuration, and privacy posture. Get actionable fix suggestions with ready-to-use header values.

name: Header Analyzer
description: Paste raw HTTP headers and get a plain-English security breakdown.
longDescription: Paste raw HTTP response headers from curl or browser DevTools and get a color-coded, plain-English security analysis. No live URL required — works for localhost, staging, and captured headers.

name: .env Exposure Analyzer
description: Identify every secret type in your .env and map the blast radius.
longDescription: Paste your .env file to identify every secret type, see which services are exposed, learn the blast radius of each leaked credential, and get step-by-step rotation instructions.

name: Privacy Scan
description: Scan any website and get a plain-English privacy nutrition label.
longDescription: Scan any URL to discover trackers, cookies, fingerprinting scripts, and data collection. Get a plain-English privacy nutrition label — what data is collected, who gets it, and how to opt out.

name: CT Monitor
description: Search Certificate Transparency logs for certificates issued for your domain.
longDescription: Search Certificate Transparency logs for all certificates issued for your domain and subdomains. Spot unauthorized issuance, phishing domains, and typosquatting attempts. Powered by crt.sh.

name: ReDoS Tester
description: Test regular expressions for catastrophic backtracking vulnerabilities.
longDescription: Paste any regex and instantly detect ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service) vulnerabilities. Identifies nested quantifiers, overlapping alternations, and exponential backtracking. Shows attack strings and timing analysis.

name: JWT Attack Workbench
description: Decode JWTs and test for real vulnerabilities — algorithm confusion, none attack, claim tampering.
longDescription: Go beyond decoding — analyze JWTs for real-world vulnerabilities. Tests algorithm none attack (CVE-2015-9235), RS256/HS256 algorithm confusion, missing expiry, excessive lifetime, sensitive data exposure, and generates forged tokens for authorized pentesting.

name: IOC Workbench
description: Extract, defang, and export indicators of compromise from any text.
longDescription: Paste threat reports, emails, or log data and instantly extract all IOCs — IPs, domains, URLs, hashes, CVEs, MITRE techniques. One-click defang for safe sharing. Export as CSV, JSON, STIX, or markdown. 100% client-side, no data leaves your browser.

name: Prompt Injection Tester
description: Test your LLM system prompts against 150+ known injection techniques.
longDescription: Paste your AI system prompt and test it against 150+ prompt injection techniques — direct overrides, delimiter escapes, encoding bypasses, extraction attacks, and 2026-era agentic hijacking patterns. Get a vulnerability score with specific hardening recommendations. 100% client-side.

name: SIEM Query Translator
description: Translate detection queries between Splunk SPL, KQL, ES|QL, Sigma, and Sumo Logic.
longDescription: Free SIEM query translator — paste a detection query in Splunk SPL, Microsoft Sentinel KQL, Elastic ES|QL, Sigma YAML, or Sumo Logic and get the equivalent in any other format. Includes field mapping, conversion caveats, and syntax highlighting. No signup, no paywall, 100% client-side.

name: Email Header Forensics
description: Analyze email headers for phishing indicators, authentication results, and routing anomalies.
longDescription: Paste raw email headers and get a visual hop-by-hop timeline, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication verdicts, delay analysis, phishing assessment score, and one-click IOC extraction. Built for SOC analysts investigating suspicious emails. 100% client-side.

name: AI Cost Calculator
description: Compare LLM API costs across Claude, GPT, Gemini, Mistral, and open-source models.
longDescription: Calculate and compare AI API costs across all major providers — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Mistral, Llama. Enter token counts or paste text to estimate. See cost breakdowns, visual comparisons, and optimization suggestions. Pricing current as of March 2026.

name: PII & Secrets Redactor
description: Detect and redact PII and secrets from logs, configs, and text with consistent pseudonymization.
longDescription: Paste logs, configs, or error reports and instantly detect and redact all PII (emails, SSNs, phones, credit cards) and secrets (API keys, tokens, connection strings). Consistent pseudonymization preserves log correlation. 200+ detection patterns. 100% client-side, no data leaves your browser.

name: CORS Debugger
description: Debug CORS errors and generate server configurations for Express, nginx, Cloudflare Workers, and more.
longDescription: Diagnose CORS issues by entering your origin, target, method, and headers. Get a plain-English explanation of what's happening, see the preflight request, and generate copy-ready server configurations for Express, nginx, Cloudflare Workers, Flask, AWS API Gateway, and Apache.

name: WAF Rule Builder
description: Build and test WAF rules — regex to Cloudflare, AWS WAF, ModSecurity, or nginx format.
longDescription: Write a regex detection pattern, test it against 100+ attack payloads (XSS, SQLi, path traversal, command injection), check for false positives, and export as a deployable rule for Cloudflare WAF, AWS WAF, ModSecurity, nginx, or Apache. Free, no signup, 100% client-side.

name: Agent Security Audit
description: Audit AI agent tool configurations for over-permissions, injection risks, and data exfiltration paths.
longDescription: Paste your AI agent's tool definitions — MCP servers, function calling schemas, or tool configs — and get a comprehensive security audit. Detects over-permissioned tools, prompt injection surfaces, data exfiltration paths, and unsafe tool combinations. The first tool of its kind for 2026-era agentic AI security.

name: SSL Chain Debugger
description: Parse, visualize, and fix SSL/TLS certificate chain ordering issues.
longDescription: Paste PEM certificates and get a visual chain diagram, validation results, and automatic chain reordering. Detects missing intermediates, wrong order, expired certs, and weak cryptography. Generate openssl commands for live debugging. 100% client-side.

name: Container Security Linter
description: Lint Kubernetes YAML, Dockerfiles, and docker-compose for security misconfigurations.
longDescription: Paste Kubernetes manifests, Dockerfiles, or docker-compose files and get instant security analysis with 40+ rules. Detects running as root, privileged containers, missing resource limits, exposed secrets, and more. Auto-generates a fixed version. 100% client-side.

name: LLM Privacy Analyzer
description: Scan LLM API requests for PII and secrets before they leave your infrastructure.
longDescription: Paste an LLM API request and scan for accidentally included PII — emails, SSNs, API keys, credit cards, and sensitive data in your prompts. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google formats. 100% client-side — because sending your PII checker to a server would defeat the purpose.

name: Email Auth Wizard
description: Build correct SPF, DKIM, and DMARC DNS records with a guided wizard.
longDescription: Generate production-ready SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records through a guided wizard. Select your email providers, configure policies, set up reporting — get copy-ready DNS TXT records with plain-English explanations and deployment guides.

name: YARA Playground
description: Write, validate, and test YARA detection rules with templates and analysis.
longDescription: YARA rule editor with syntax validation, 10+ rule templates (malware, webshells, packers, crypto miners), performance analysis, hex string builder, and approximate pattern matching. The regex101 for threat detection. 100% client-side.

name: Sigma Rule Builder
description: Visual builder for Sigma detection rules with YAML preview and SIEM export.
longDescription: Build Sigma detection rules through a guided form — define logsource, detection logic with modifiers, MITRE ATT&CK tags, and metadata. Get live YAML preview and one-click export to Splunk SPL, KQL, or ES|QL. No more hand-writing YAML. 100% client-side.

name: AI Model Scanner
description: Scan AI model cards and configs for security risks, unsafe serialization, and supply chain issues.
longDescription: Paste a HuggingFace model card, config.json, or requirements.txt and scan for security risks — unsafe pickle serialization, vulnerable dependencies, missing safety metadata, supply chain red flags, and training data concerns. The npm audit for AI models. 100% client-side.

name: Passkey Inspector
description: Decode WebAuthn attestation, authenticator data & COSE keys
longDescription: Create a passkey live or paste an existing attestation object and decode everything — CBOR attestation, authenticator-data flags (UP/UV/BE/BS), AAGUID, credential ID, and the COSE public key. A free, fully client-side WebAuthn/FIDO2 inspector.

name: Entropy X-ray
description: Spot encryption, packing & secrets by byte entropy
longDescription: Visualize Shannon entropy across any file or pasted data to reveal encrypted, compressed, or packed regions and embedded secrets. Includes a per-offset entropy sweep and a byte histogram — a browser-based malware-triage and reverse-engineering tool.

name: Key Converter
description: Convert keys between JWK and PEM, generate keypairs locally
longDescription: Free client-side cryptographic key converter and inspector. Convert between JWK and PEM (SPKI / PKCS#8), generate fresh RSA and EC keypairs, and inspect key parameters using the browser's Web Crypto API — nothing is ever uploaded.

name: Local Chat
description: Chat with a real LLM that runs entirely on your machine.
longDescription: A private AI assistant that runs 100% on your own device — in-browser via WebGPU, or wired to your own Ollama / LM Studio server, or an API key you control. No accounts, no servers of ours, nothing you type is ever uploaded.

name: Chat with your files
description: Drop your docs and ask questions — retrieval + LLM, 100% offline.
longDescription: Chat with your own documents, notes, and code entirely offline. Drop in text, markdown, CSV, logs, or source files and this local RAG assistant chunks and embeds them right in your browser, retrieves the most relevant passages by semantic similarity, and answers with cited sources — nothing is ever uploaded.

name: Regex from English
description: Describe a pattern in plain English; get a tested regex — locally.
longDescription: Turn a plain-English description into a working regular expression for JavaScript, PCRE, or Python, then watch it match your sample text live in the browser. A local AI model does the translation and can explain any regex you paste token-by-token — with nothing ever leaving your machine.

name: Command Explainer
description: Explain any shell/git/docker/kubectl command + flag a danger before you run it.
longDescription: A local-AI command explainer that breaks down any shell, git, docker, or kubectl command line into plain English, part by part, and runs an instant in-browser danger scanner that flags destructive patterns like rm -rf, curl|sh, and fork bombs before you ever hit enter. Describe intent in English and it generates the command, then re-scans it — all client-side, nothing uploaded.

name: AI Security Copilot
description: Paste a header, JWT, cert, or config; get a local AI risk assessment.
longDescription: A local-AI security analyst that runs entirely in your browser: it decodes JWTs, inventories HTTP security headers, parses X.509 TLS certificates, audits Content-Security-Policies, and scans configs for secrets deterministically, then reasons over those facts to produce a risk summary, severity-ranked findings, and concrete remediations — with nothing uploaded.

name: EXIF Viewer & Scrubber
description: See the GPS & camera data hidden in your photos, then strip it.
longDescription: Inspect every hidden EXIF tag, GPS coordinate, timestamp, and metadata field baked into your JPEG, PNG, or WebP photos, then download a scrubbed copy with a single click. Everything runs entirely in your browser — your images are never uploaded, so the GPS location and device details they leak never leave your device.

name: Image Converter & Compressor
description: Convert & compress PNG, JPEG, WebP in your browser — batch, private
longDescription: Convert and compress images between PNG, JPEG, and WebP with a live before/after preview, quality slider, and aspect-preserving resize — all processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is ever uploaded, so batch-optimizing sensitive images stays completely private.

name: Color Contrast Lab
description: WCAG & APCA contrast checker with instant accessible-color fixes
longDescription: Check WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios and APCA Lc scores for any text and background pair entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded. Get instant AA/AAA pass-fail, one-click fixes for failing colors, and an accessible tonal palette generator.

name: Open Graph Image Studio
description: Design 1200×630 social cards and export a PNG, all in your browser
longDescription: Create polished Open Graph and Twitter card images at the exact 1200×630 size social platforms expect — with live canvas preview, tasteful presets, gradient and mesh backgrounds, and logo or emoji support. Everything renders in your browser and exports as a crisp PNG; your images and text are never uploaded.

name: Favicon & PWA Asset Generator
description: Generate a full favicon + PWA icon set from an image, emoji, or monogram
longDescription: Build a complete favicon and PWA icon set — 16, 32, 48, 180, 192, and 512 PNGs plus a real favicon.ico, the exact HTML link tags, and a site.webmanifest — entirely in your browser. Your source image never leaves your device; nothing is uploaded.
